# Support Guide

Welcome to the Project Beacon support page. Whether you are setting up a local off-grid mesh node, developing custom apps using our SDK, or facing compilation issues, we want to help.

Please review the following support resources:

---

## 1. Check the Documentation First
Before asking a question, please review our comprehensive documentation:
* **Product Vision & Goals:** [Vision Document](docs/vision/vision_template.md)
* **API & Integrations:** [SDK Specification](docs/sdk/sdk_template.md)
* **FAQ / Glossary:** [Glossary](docs/glossary/README.md)
* **Current Status:** [PROJECT_STATUS.md](PROJECT_STATUS.md)

## 3. Troubleshooting & Opening Issues
If you encounter a software bug or build failure:
* **Search Existing Issues:** Search our [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/broskifoo/Project-Beacon/issues) to see if someone has already reported the issue.
* **Open a Bug Report:** If the issue is new, open a bug report using our [Bug Report Template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md).
* **Provide Context:** Always include your microcontroller model, companion phone OS version, and console logs.
